Where yesterday’s tales
create today’s stories
Castle Elvira is a Luxury Hotel dominating the St Elia Ridge in Salento, only ten minutes from the breathtaking city of Lecce, aka: “The Florence of the south”.
Constructed in the late 19th century, but abandoned for more than 100 years, Castle Elvira was discovered again in 2018 and underwent a magnificent four year restoration. In 2022 and to international acclaim, Elvira finally reopened her freshly painted castle doors and welcomed her first guests after more than a century.
In 2023 Elvira was presented with countless industry awards, including “Best Art and design Hotel in Europe”.
Inside the castle and her other historical buildings, 20th century design details meet eclectic furnishing and state of the art technology to create the ultimate luxury guest experience in this art and design led luxury boutique hotel.
ABOUT US
Stay at Castle Elvira
and Tower Elvira
Elvira consists of four beautifully restored historically important buildings, the castle, the medieval tower, the ancient masseria and the castle cottage. The hotel sits on a gated private estate consisting of 37 acres of woodland, olive and citrus groves, and three stunning stone pools sunken into the estate’s Italian gardens. The Elvira restaurant and bar is housed in the estate’s original olive oil farm and there is an additional castle rooftop terrace cocktail and sunset bar. The castle also offers a large guest salon, a private dining room and a private cinema. Our front office is open 24 hours and also offers concierge services to help plan guests itineraries and assist with any external reservations our guests might require.

The Castle Castle Elvira
Vai al contenuto
THE CASTLE
ABOUT
The Elvira
CASTLE
Castle Elvira was commissioned by a wealthy Romani military general and entrepreneur and was to be his family’s summer residence, the perfect place to escape the hot summers in Rome. The castle was named after the generals teenage daughter, Elvira, and the family took up residence in the castle the same summer that the construction was completed, but due to the tragic death of their beloved daughter in that first year, the heartbroken family locked the castle doors and left the castle that same summer and they never returned.
Current owners, Steven and Harvey, discovered the abandoned castle whilst touring Salento in 2018, they immediately fell in love with her and decided to rewrite history and breath a second life into the castle, the rest as they say is history.
The Elvira
Estate
The Elvira 37 acre estate runs adjacent to an ancient street called Via Andrano, which sits atop the St Elia Ridge, the St Elia Ridge takes its name from the St Elia Convent, which is located just west of the castle, it is a beautiful, alas unrestored ancient Ecclesiastical building. Via Andrano is known to the locals as the Vale of Health, because it is considered to have the sweetest and purest air in Salento and every day you will see many runners and joggers on this road.
The Original
Castle
The original estate was an ancient Roman farm, but this was destroyed many hundreds of years ago, the Castle and the new farm were created in the late 19th century. The estate originally produced the highest quality olive oil, although the estate also produced fruits and other crops, even peaches at one time.
Tower Elvira, although its lower room would have also been used also as a farm building, the towers rooftop and upper level was the guards quarters and a watch tower for any invaders attacking the Convent, Puglia and especially Salento was the target of constant invasions, these invasions contributed to Puglia’s amazing and interesting history, the Tower predates the castle by at least 300 years.

Winter
At Castle Elvira
From November 1st, Castle Elvira opens its doors in a warm and refined atmosphere: heated floors, fireplaces lit every evening, and six elegant suites between the Castle and the Cottage, accommodating up to 12 guests. You can book individual rooms or the entire property exclusively. We open the restaurant for groups of more than 8 guests; for smaller groups, the chef serves his menus in the Castle’s kitchen and dining room.
During your stay, you can relax in the heated pool, enjoy drinks at sunset on the roof terrace or in the lounge by the fireplaces, and take advantage of included services such as continental breakfast, housekeeping, and overnight reception. On request, we can also arrange airport transfers and personalized services to make your stay truly unforgettable.
Elvira Pools
Elvira Pools
Elvira offers three stunning pools, two pools in the Castle gardens and one in the Towers gardens, there is also a large jacuzzi between the castles pools. All pools adorned with locally quarried stone and the tower pool and the jacuzzi can be heated. The two pool areas offer a very different ambience, the castle pools are immersed in beautiful terraced Italian gardens that step down gently from the castle to the pools, the atmosphere here is serene and tranquil, whereas the tower pool is set amongst local cacti and succulents and on located on flatter ground, the tower pool surrounded by ancient dry stone walls. All pools have wifi connectivity and allows out gusts to connect to the pols sound system and play their own playlists and music. We offer drinks service at all pools.
The Location
The Location
Castle Elvira is located on Via Andrano, and is close to three small villages. Lecce (The Florence of the South) is only 10 minutes from the castle, and there is easy access to both coastlines.
The Ionian coast with its long white sandy beaches is only 20 minutes from Elvira and the Adriatic, with its rocky dramatic coast is only10 Minutes away.
In this very convenient and central location, you will have easy access to Ostuni and its surrounding villages, Otranto, Gallipoli, Nardo, Manduria, and many other beautiful and well known cities and towns. Brindisi airport is just 30 minutes away, and Bari airport is one hour and 45 minutes away. Our front office and concierge assists out guests with any transfers our transport requirements.
Tower Elvira
Tower Elvira
Tower Elvira is the castle’s sister residences, in the immediate vicinity of the castle. The tower and the ancient masseria offer the same super luxury and quality as the castle in four other incredibly unique suites. The tower has a stunning heated pool and a beautiful gardens and landscape full of cacti, pepper trees, giant agave, and olive, lemon, and orange trees. The castle and tower suites can accommodate a maximum of 22 guests and it is possible to arrange an exclusive buyout of the entire estate.
